title: kbext.configured answers False for an extension point whose entry point sits in a distribution under an extension_paths directory, so a shipped tool falls back to its default silently
goal: kbext.configured is true for an it_ops_kb.POINT entry point whose distribution sits under a directory of extension_paths, as kbext.load finds it

run:
import json,sys,tempfile,pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
T=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
site=T/"site"; (site/"gx-0.1.dist-info").mkdir(parents=True)
(site/"gx-0.1.dist-info"/"METADATA").write_text("Metadata-Version: 2.1\nName: gx\nVersion: 0.1\n")
(site/"gx-0.1.dist-info"/"entry_points.txt").write_text("[it_ops_kb.ranker]\ngx = gcmds\n")
(T/"ws").mkdir()
(T/"ws"/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"extension_paths":[str(site)]}))
import kbext
sys.exit(0 if kbext.configured("ranker", T/"ws") else "not yet: configured misses an entry point under extension_paths")
